items.text: Merrill stated it had 446 advisors named to the 2025 Forbes 'Top Next-Generation Wealth Advisors Best-in-State' list, more than any other firm, reflecting its strength in developing and attracting next-generation advisors.
items.quote: Recognized more than any other firm, Merrill had 446 advisors named to the 2025 Forbes "Top Next-Generation Wealth Advisors Best-in-State" list (Published on August 6, 2025. Rankings based on data as of March 31, 2025.)

items.text: Merrill noted it ranked No. 1 on Forbes' Top Next Generation Advisors (2025) list, indicating a strategic emphasis on cultivating next-generation advisors.
items.quote: No. 1 on Forbes' Top Women Wealth Advisors Best-in-State (2025), Best-in-State Wealth Management Teams (2026), Top Next Generation Advisors (2025), and Top Wealth Management Teams High Net Worth (2025)

items.text: CFO Alastair Borthwick said Merrill's approach centers on a training program to train people in wealth management at Bank of America and Merrill, which the firm believes it can keep driving to improve net new flows.
items.quote: it's a training program so that we're training people in wealth management, Bank of America, and Merrill, and that's ultimately what we believe we can just keep driving in order to improve the net new flows.

items.text: CFO Alastair Borthwick said Merrill continues to attract talent across both new and experienced advisers as part of driving productivity and long-term client relationships.
items.quote: We're driving productivity higher on both newer and existing members of our financial advisers team, and we continue to attract talent across both new and experienced advisers.

items.text: CFO Alastair Borthwick said both Merrill and the Private Bank continued to attract talented advisers drawn to the breadth of the platform and ability to deliver comprehensive solutions for clients.
items.quote: both Merrill and the Private Bank continued to attract talented advisers who are drawn to the breadth of our platform and our ability to deliver comprehensive solutions for clients.

items.text: CFO Alastair Borthwick attributed strong results to demand for advice and the firm's ability to attract clients and experienced advisers to the platform.
items.quote: These results reflect strong demand for advice, and our ability to attract clients and experienced advisers to the platform.

items.text: Merrill operates an Advisor Development Program designed to train and progress individuals into financial advisor roles, building the next generation of its advisor force.
items.quote: After mastering key objectives and pre-determined targets, progress through three roles until you graduate to Merrill Core Advisor.

items.text: Merrill executives touted that recruited assets to the wealth unit doubled year-over-year as the firm returned to veteran broker recruiting, with Co-Presidents Lindsay Hans and Eric Schimpf restoring a focus on hiring and a more aggressive offer after taking over in 2023.
items.quote: Merrill executives in October touted that recruited assets to the wealth unit doubled year-over-year as the firm has returned to veteran broker recruiting. The firm largely pulled back from veteran broker recruiting at the end of 2017 but returned after Co-Presidents Lindsay Hans and Eric Schimpf, who took over in 2023, restored a focus on hiring and a more aggressive offer.

items.text: Merrill launched Tax Efficient Transition Service and Dollar Cost Averaging Service, new services combining automation with portfolio oversight to help clients simplify asset transitions and cash deployment into managed strategies, including for clients moving appreciated assets.
items.quote: Merrill today announced the launch of Tax Efficient Transition Service (TET) and Dollar Cost Averaging Service (DCA), new services that combine automation with professional portfolio oversight to help clients simplify asset transitions and cash deployment into managed or custom managed investment strategies
